_comment: Chip-Backed Finance Observatory - monitoring configuration. Edit keywords, feeds and publication mode here; never edit watch.py. After changing terms, run: python3 -m unittest discover tests
_auto_publish_mode_options: off = candidates only; the workflow opens a GitHub issue and the curator adds real deals by hand (recommended) | direct = also append entries to observatory-data.json as PENDING REVIEW (listed apart on the site, never counted). Any other value is treated as off.
_terms_comment: Matching is whole-word and case-insensitive; a plural s/es is allowed automatically; a trailing * makes a prefix. strong_phrases match in title or summary. The other rules look at the TITLE only: tech_terms + finance_terms, or context_terms + strong_finance_terms. exclude_terms in the title always reject.
_edgar_comment: One candidate per filing. Forms below are skipped (fund prospectuses, proxy and merger filings, ownership reports). edgar_max_hits caps paging per query; the digest says TRUNCATED when it is reached.
_press_release_comment: GlobeNewswire's RSS refuses automated clients (HTTP 403), so press-release wires are searched through Google News instead.
tier1_google_news_queries: GPU financing site:prnewswire.com OR site:businesswire.com OR site:globenewswire.com
GPU-backed OR "secured by GPUs" site:prnewswire.com OR site:businesswire.com OR site:globenewswire.com
